rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something changing or progressing gradually.

example.english: The weather is gradually getting colder again.
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 maan6 maan6 dung3 faan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the progress is explicitly made step by step or in stages.

example.english: We gradually completed the plan step by step.
example.traditional: 我哋一步一步咁完成個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 gam2 jyun4 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6
